evidence.reason: The fixture configures only user.name/user.email and never disables inherited commit.gpgSign. In a host or CI environment where global commit.gpgSign=true and no usable signing key matches the fixture identity, the baseline commit fails, causing every DeployTests case to error in setUp(). Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is a minimal hermetic fix and also covers later fixture commits without altering developer configuration.
